projects.name: AND IMPACT
projects.description:
AND IMPACT
Kafka, Python and Redis Event Processing Pipeline
Built an event-driven processing project using Node.js producers, Kafka topics, and Python consumers to process financial data and notification events asynchronously.
Used consumer groups and partitions for parallel processing, with retry topics, dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers, structured logging, and health metrics for fault tolerance.
Used Redis for status caching, idempotency keys, rate limiting, and short-lived distributed locks, reducing repeated work and protecting downstream APIs.
Bulk Client Activation Platform
Replaced long-running activation requests with BullMQ background jobs that process up to 10,000 clients per batch without keeping API requests open.
Added progress tracking, safe retries, failed-job reporting, automatic emails, and idempotent reprocessing so successful clients are not processed again after a failed retry.
Scalable Notification System
Built a Node.js notification service where application services add jobs to BullMQ/Redis and workers load templates, recipient data, and provider configuration before sending messages.
Used MongoDB for flexible notification payloads and delivery metadata, with indexing and pagination for efficient API access and failure tracking.
Scaled delivery using multiple workers, controlled concurrency, provider rate limits, retries, duplicate protection, and failed-job tracking.
Multi-Tenant White-Label SaaS on AWS
Hosted one React build on private AWS S3 and delivered it through CloudFront for multiple advisor brands and custom domains.
Implemented tenant resolution, branding configuration, and tenant headers so new white-label customers could be onboarded without separate application builds.
Authentication, Authorization and Secure Share Links
Built tenant-aware login flows for first-party, white-label, and third-party applications using OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE, single-use state, secure cookies, and tenant-specific redirect configuration.
Created time-limited share links with OTP verification, attempt limits, access sessions, audit logs, and server-side workflow rules for risk profiling and onboarding.
Financial API Integrations - MF Central and BSE
Integrated MF Central APIs through a reusable Node.js service for authentication, request validation, response mapping, timeouts, retries, and consistent error handling.
Built a common BSE API integration layer with credential handling, audit logs, and automated 14-day password rotation using encrypted storage, scheduled checks, reminders, and failure alerts.
Financial Dashboard, GraphQL/AppSync and Python/FastAPI Use Case
Built financial dashboards with a common data layer, TanStack Query caching, clear loading/error states, and optimized React rendering.
Implemented GraphQL APIs with AWS AppSync for dashboard and notification data, defining schemas, queries, mutations, and resolvers backed by Node.js Lambda and existing REST services.
Integrated Python/FastAPI endpoints for internal data-processing services using Pydantic schemas, async request handling, Redis caching, validation, structured errors, and automatically generated OpenAPI documentation.
